start_commands: Plan a descriptive measurement on the archived 2O0O crystal coordinates. The provisional follow-up is the shared four-atom backbone. For a deep investigation, delegate a pilot coverage inventory on 2RE9 before choosing the follow-up: if fewer than 60 percent of the observed positions survive the inventory selection, reassess the atom selection for 2O0O. For a methods survey, check applicability using the supplied public workflow card. Report the actual atom selection and coverage, with its source. Deposited model 1, entity 1, asymmetric-unit chains A/B/C only.
